materials.title: 一般现在时：我和他人的日常

source.rights: 原创 AI 辅助虚构草稿；未启用，尚待独立语义与发音审核。

questions.prompt: Use the simple present: I ____ at ten.
questions.evidence: I start at ten.
questions.explanation: I 后的一般现在时用原形 start；starts 用于 he/she，starting 单独使用缺助动词，started 是过去式。

questions.prompt: Use the simple present: She ____ at ten.
questions.evidence: She starts at ten.
questions.explanation: 一般现在时 she 后用 starts；start 不合此处主谓搭配，starting 单独使用缺助动词，started 是过去式。

questions.prompt: Use the simple present: I ____ at four.
questions.evidence: I finish at four.
questions.explanation: I 后的一般现在时用原形 finish；finishes 用于 he/she，finishing 单独使用缺助动词，finished 是过去式。

questions.prompt: Use the simple present: He ____ at four.
questions.evidence: He finishes at four.
questions.explanation: 一般现在时 he 后用 finishes；finish 不合此处主谓搭配，finishing 单独使用缺助动词，finished 是过去式。

questions.prompt: Complete the negative: I ____ not leave at six.
questions.evidence: I do not leave at six.
questions.explanation: 主语 I 的一般现在时否定用 do not；does 用于 he/she，am 和 is 不能替代这里的 do。

questions.prompt: Complete the negative: She ____ not leave at six.
questions.evidence: She does not leave at six.
questions.explanation: 主语 she 的一般现在时否定用 does not；do、are 和 is 不能构成这个结构。

questions.prompt: Complete the negative: I do not ____ at five.
questions.evidence: I do not start at five.
questions.explanation: do not 后用动词原形 start；starts、starting 和 started 不能直接用在这里。

questions.prompt: Complete the negative: He does not ____ at five.
questions.evidence: He does not start at five.
questions.explanation: does not 后仍用原形 start，不能再加 -s；其他形式也不符合这个否定句。

questions.prompt: Complete the question: ____ you read this note every day?
questions.evidence: 询问习惯时，Do 放在 I / you 前，Does 放在 he / she 前；后面用动词原形。简短回答与提问中的 do / does 一致。
questions.explanation: 询问 you 的动作习惯用 Do；Does 对应 he/she，Is 和 Are 不构成这个动作问句。

questions.prompt: Complete the question: ____ he put on a shirt every morning?
questions.evidence: 询问习惯时，Do 放在 I / you 前，Does 放在 he / she 前；后面用动词原形。简短回答与提问中的 do / does 一致。
questions.explanation: 询问 he 的动作习惯用 Does，后面 put 保持原形；Do、Is 和 Are 不符合这个结构。

questions.prompt: Answer the question: Does she leave at ten every day? Yes, she ____.
questions.evidence: 询问习惯时，Do 放在 I / you 前，Does 放在 he / she 前；后面用动词原形。简短回答与提问中的 do / does 一致。
questions.explanation: Does she 开头的肯定简答用 Yes, she does；do、is 和 are 与该问句不对应。

questions.prompt: Answer the question: Do you stay here on class days? No, I ____ not.
questions.evidence: 询问习惯时，Do 放在 I / you 前，Does 放在 he / she 前；后面用动词原形。简短回答与提问中的 do / does 一致。
questions.explanation: Do you 问句的否定简答为 No, I do not；does 用于 he/she，am 和 is 不对应这里的动作问句。

materials.instructions: 先读中文解释和例句，做前 8 道引导题，再做 4 道新情境题；不确定时可回看规则。
materials.passage:
1. 一般现在时描述习惯。I 和 you 后通常用动词原形；he 和 she 表示一个人时，动词通常加 -s，部分词加 -es。先找主语再选动词。
例句：I start at ten. She starts at ten. I finish at four. He finishes at four.

2. 否定习惯时，I / you 后用 do not 加动词原形；he / she 后用 does not 加动词原形。does 已表示第三人称，后面的动词不再加 -s。
例句：I do not leave at six. She does not leave at six. I do not start at five. He does not start at five.

3. 询问习惯时，Do 放在 I / you 前，Does 放在 he / she 前；后面用动词原形。简短回答与提问中的 do / does 一致。
例句：Do you eat lunch? Does she eat lunch?

materials.title: Hana’s Class Day

source.rights: 原创 AI 辅助虚构草稿；未启用，尚待独立语义与发音审核。

questions.prompt: When does Hana wake on class days?
questions.evidence: On class days, I wake at six.
questions.explanation: Hana 说上课日六点醒；Leo 五点醒，四点是下课时间，十点是上课时间。

questions.prompt: What does Hana choose to wear today?
questions.evidence: I choose the shirt today. The dress is for tomorrow.
questions.explanation: 她今天选衬衫，连衣裙留到明天；原文没有说选另一顶帽子或 Leo 的衬衫。

questions.prompt: Where does Hana put her socks?
options: Inside her shoes before putting them on.
questions.evidence: I put a sock on each foot.
questions.explanation: 她先在每只脚上穿一只袜子，再穿鞋；不是只穿一只脚，也不是先把袜子放进鞋里。

questions.prompt: When does Hana put on her hat?
questions.evidence: I put a hat on my head before I leave.
questions.explanation: 她明确在出门前戴帽子；文中没有说午饭、下课或晚饭后才戴。

questions.prompt: When does Hana start class?
questions.evidence: I start class at ten.
questions.explanation: Hana 十点开始上课；五和六是起床时间，四是下课时间。

questions.prompt: Who wakes at five?
questions.evidence: Leo starts at ten too. He wakes at five, but I wake at six.
questions.explanation: 前一句说明 He 指 Leo，他五点醒；Hana 六点醒，老师和全组的起床时间没有给出。

questions.prompt: When does Hana read the note?
questions.evidence: After lunch, I read a short note.
questions.explanation: 她午饭后读短便条；原文没有说她在上课前、午饭前或晚饭后读这张便条。

questions.prompt: When does Hana finish class?
questions.evidence: I finish class at four.
questions.explanation: Hana 四点结束上课；一点吃午饭，五点是 Leo 起床时间，十点开始上课。

questions.prompt: Why does Hana stay in the room for five minutes?
questions.evidence: I stay in the room for five minutes to check my note.
questions.explanation: 她留五分钟检查便条；晚饭、选择连衣裙和见新小组不是这次留下的原因。

questions.prompt: What does Hana write before dinner?
options: A note for Leo about his lunch.
questions.evidence: Before dinner, I write a note for tomorrow.
questions.explanation: 晚饭前她写一张给明天用的便条；没有说写晚饭食品清单、Leo 的午饭便条或下周便条。

materials.instructions: 先按小段读，圈出人物和数字；每题选择一个答案，回到原句核对。
materials.passage:
My name is Hana. Today I have an English class. On class days, I wake at six. I get up. My bed is near the chair. The room is cool. I wash my face and look at my hair. My shirt is on a chair. A dress is on the chair too. I choose the shirt today. The dress is for tomorrow.

I put a sock on each foot. Then I put on one shoe and the other. The sun is out. I put a hat on my head before I leave. At the door, I lift my hand and wave to my friend Leo. A short walk helps my body feel ready for class.

I take a quick look at the time. I take a slow walk to class. I start class at ten. Leo starts at ten too. He wakes at five, but I wake at six. We meet our group at the table. We open our books and say hello to the teacher. I do not need to hurry.

I eat lunch at one. After lunch, I read a short note. I finish class at four. Leo finishes at four too. I stay in the room for five minutes to check my note. Then I leave. Leo has a question for the teacher, so he stays for a short time too.

I eat dinner at six. Before dinner, I write a note for tomorrow. It has my class time and one question. This is my plan for a class day. Leo has a different plan. We can change our plans when we need to.

materials.title: Nia and Cal Talk About Their Day

questions.prompt: When does Nia wake on class days?
questions.evidence: On class days, I wake at five.
questions.explanation: Nia 说上课日五点醒；Cal 六点醒，三点结束上课，十点开始上课。

questions.prompt: Where is Cal’s shoe?
questions.evidence: My shoe is under the bed.
questions.explanation: Cal 说他的鞋在床下；其他地点没有被说成鞋的位置。

questions.prompt: What color is Nia’s shirt today?
questions.evidence: I have a blue shirt today.
questions.explanation: Nia 说今天的衬衫是蓝色；绿、黄、棕没有作为她今天衬衫的颜色。

questions.prompt: Why does Nia put on a hat before she leaves?
options: Her shoe is under the bed.
questions.evidence: The sun is out, so I put a hat on my head before I leave.
questions.explanation: 她说太阳出来了，所以出门前戴帽子；她提过房间凉爽，床下的鞋是 Cal 的，老师没有要求她戴帽子。

questions.prompt: When does Cal start class?
questions.evidence: I start class at ten.
questions.explanation: Cal 说十点上课；五、六是起床时间，三点是下课时间。

questions.prompt: When does Nia eat lunch?
questions.evidence: I eat lunch at one and finish class at three.
questions.explanation: Nia 一点吃午饭，三点下课；五点起床，六点吃晚饭。

questions.prompt: Why does Nia stay in the room after class?
options: To check a note for the teacher.
answers: To check a note for the teacher.
questions.evidence: After class, I stay in the room for five minutes. I check a note for the teacher.
questions.explanation: 她下课后留下五分钟检查给老师的便条；没有说留下吃晚饭、等到十点或找鞋。

questions.prompt: What does Cal do after class?
options: He takes a quick walk to the shop.
He puts his shoe under the bed.
He takes a slow walk to the shop.
He starts another class at ten.
answers: He takes a slow walk to the shop.
questions.evidence: Then I leave with you. I take a slow walk to the shop.
questions.explanation: Cal 随 Nia 离开并慢慢走去商店；他没有说快走、把鞋放床下或十点再开始一节课。

questions.prompt: When does Nia eat dinner?
questions.evidence: I eat dinner at six.
questions.explanation: Nia 六点吃晚饭；一点吃午饭，三点下课，五点起床。

questions.prompt: Which item does Nia say she plans to wear tomorrow?
questions.evidence: I plan to wear my dress tomorrow.
questions.explanation: Nia 说计划明天穿连衣裙；蓝衬衫和帽子是她今天使用的物品，Cal 的衬衫也不是她说的明日计划。

materials.instructions: 先按对话分段听人物与数字，再做题；音频尚未生成，当前文字仅供草稿审核。
materials.transcript:
Nia: Hello, Cal. On class days, I wake at five. I get up and wash my face. My room is cool. What time do you wake?

Cal: I wake at six. I put on a shirt. I put a sock on each foot. My shoe is under the bed. I find it and put it on.

Nia: I have a blue shirt today. I also have a dress, but I choose the shirt. The sun is out, so I put a hat on my head before I leave.

Cal: I take a quick look at my note. I start class at ten. Do you start at ten too? We can meet our group at the table.

Nia: Yes. I start at ten. I eat lunch at one and finish class at three. After class, I stay in the room for five minutes. I check a note for the teacher.

Cal: I finish at three too. Then I leave with you. I take a slow walk to the shop. A short walk helps my body feel ready for the next part of the day.

Nia: I lift my hand to wave to a friend. I eat dinner at six. Before dinner, I write my class time for tomorrow. I plan to wear my dress tomorrow.

Cal: That is a good plan. I check my hair before dinner. I do not need the same plan as you. We can each choose our own times.

I eat dinner at six. Before dinner, I write a short plan for tomorrow.
